title: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.14511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. translated_title: Pyrite：构建与基准测试蛋白质-配体构象排序智能体
translated_abstract: 预测配体如何与靶标结合是小分子药物发现的核心。现代共折叠模型能够生成多样化的候选构象，但可靠地对这些候选进行排序仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了Pyrite，一个成对构象排序基准，包含来自多种蛋白质-配体复合物的1,500个构象对。配备3D可视化工具和基于物理的评分的专家化学家的表现接近随机水平，这凸显了解释现有化学信号的困难。为了研究自动化排序，我们引入了PyriteRep，一种对分子几何结构、蛋白质-配体相互作用和物理化学评分的结构化表示，并开发了两个基于LLM的智能体：PyriteReasoner，通过基于文本的推理直接比较构象；PyriteFeaturizer，生成可执行代码来构建用于逻辑回归的特征，并可选择性地整合来自LLM子调用派生的特征。这些智能体……
tldr: 提出了包含1500个蛋白质-配体构象对的成对构象排序基准Pyrite，发现专家化学家的排序表现接近随机水平，并开发了两个基于大语言模型的智能体（PyriteReasoner和PyriteFeaturizer）来实现自动化构象排序。
en_tdlr: Introduces Pyrite, a pairwise protein-ligand pose ranking benchmark of 1,500 pose pairs where expert chemists perform near chance, and develops two LLM-based agents (PyriteReasoner and PyriteFeaturizer) for automated pose ranking.
